overview.description: The iShares U.S. Manufacturing ETF (MADE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P U.S. Manufacturing Select index. The fund is passively managed to invest in US equity securities that derive revenues from manufacturing and manufacturing-related sectors. The fund optimizes the portfolio by setting weight limits for select sectors. MADE was launched on Jul 17, 2024 and is issued by BlackRock.
